common.noExplorer: This network has no public explorer
common.footer: Public chain: flows and proofs. Never people.
common.confirmLink: Open the confirmation page for this delivery
common.noWalletHint: No wallet extension found — the passkey wallet needs nothing installed.

errors.indexerBody: Could not reach the indexer at {url}. Figures appear once it is running and has synced.
errors.noDeploymentBody: This build is locked to chain {chainId} ({network}), but no deployment is bundled for it. Run the deploy scripts and rebuild the shared package.
errors.wrongNetwork: Your wallet is on another chain. Switch to {chain} to continue.
errors.connectFirst: Connect a wallet to use this page.
errors.invalidAmount: Enter an amount with at most 6 decimals.
errors.invalidTranches: The tranche plan must sum to exactly 100%.
errors.invalidEuro: Enter an amount in euros with at most 2 decimals.

tx.sponsoredHint: A paymaster paid the network fee for this transaction.

timeline.title: Full timeline
timeline.description: Every state change, with a link to the transaction and, where one exists, to the attestation behind it.

home.title: Aid you can audit, beneficiaries you cannot identify
home.lead: Register verified needs, follow every donation from donor to delivery, and prove aid arrived — without ever putting a person on a public chain.
home.totalsNote: Recomputed by the indexer from on-chain events only.
home.flow1Body: An NGO registers a need with a tranche plan. Independent verifiers attest it on EAS; only then is a vault deployed.
home.flow2Body: Stablecoin goes into a vault owned by nobody. Each donation mints a soulbound receipt you can trace.
home.flow3Body: When funding closes, tranche 0 is released so the NGO can buy goods before delivering them.
home.flow4Body: Field evidence is hashed and attested, beneficiaries confirm anonymously with zero-knowledge proofs, and an independent verifier signs off.
home.flow5Title: Only then does the next tranche unlock
home.flow5Body: After a challenge window the delivery finalizes and the next tranche becomes releasable. The last release completes the need.
home.privacyBody: No name, identity number, phone number, exact location or photo. Beneficiaries appear only as unlinkable Semaphore commitments, and a confirmation reveals a nullifier and nothing else.

needs.title: Needs
needs.subtitle: Every need registered on chain, with what has been raised against it.
needs.count: {count, plural, =0 {No needs} one {# need} other {# needs}}
needs.emptyBody: Clear the filters, or check that the indexer has synced.

need.title: Need #{id}
need.trancheNote: Tranche 0 pre-finances the work. Every later tranche unlocks only when its delivery is finalized. Each one is paid straight to the need’s payment plan.
need.deliveriesNote: Evidence, anonymous confirmations and an independent sign-off must all agree before money moves.
need.donateBody: Two transactions: approve the vault to move your {unit}, then donate. Overfunding is rejected on purpose.
need.donateClosed: This need is not accepting donations.
need.donateSuccess: Thank you. Your soulbound receipt has been minted; follow it from the donations page.
need.donationOffchain: Card or bank, held by the provider
need.expireBody: Anyone can apply the terms now: funding closes on what was raised if it meets the minimum, otherwise the need expires and refunds open.
need.refundWallet: Donated from a wallet? Claim your share of the money that was never released, from the same wallet you donated with.
need.refundFiat: Gave by card or bank transfer? The payment provider returns your share to the original payment method; follow it on your tracking page.
need.conversionLine: Converted from {amountIn} {symbol} · fair value {fairValue} {unit} · conversion cost {fee} {unit}
need.conversionMixed: Converted from several tokens · fair value {fairValue} {unit} · conversion cost {fee} {unit}
need.conversionPending: Converted on-chain; the conversion details are still being indexed.
need.donateConvertedBody: Given in {symbol} and converted on-chain into {unit} at Chainlink prices, within a slippage bound the contract enforces. Your wallet approves and donates in one step when it can bundle them.
need.donateMinimum: The conversion returns at least {minimum} {unit} ({percent}% below fair value) or the transaction reverts and nothing moves.
need.donateQuoteUnavailable: No live price right now (a price feed is stale or the route is not configured), so a converted donation would revert.
need.donateInvalidToken: Enter an amount in {symbol} with at most {decimals} decimals.
need.donateReturned: The need can only take part of this: up to {used} {symbol} is converted and donated, and the other {returned} {symbol} is returned to your wallet unconverted.

donor.title: My donations
donor.subtitle: Your soulbound receipts, and what each one actually paid for.
donor.emptyBody: Donations made from this wallet appear here, with the deliveries they funded.

ngo.title: NGO console
ngo.subtitle: Programs, needs, funding and impact reports. Every action is a transaction you sign.
ngo.programBody: A program is one Semaphore group. Beneficiary commitments are enrolled into it; the policy hash commits to the published eligibility rules.
ngo.membersBody: Paste the commitments beneficiaries showed you, one per line. A commitment is an unlinkable number: it is not personal data, and nothing else about the person is sent anywhere.
ngo.needBody: The needs assessment stays with your vault service; only its hash reaches the chain. The terms you set here are shown to every donor and cannot be changed later.
ngo.tranchePlan: Tranche plan, in percent, comma separated
ngo.closeBody: Closing splits what was raised across the tranche plan and makes tranche 0 releasable. You can close early only once the minimum funding has been reached.
ngo.releaseBody: Anyone can trigger a release once a tranche is releasable; the money always goes to your registered payout address.
ngo.impactBody: An ImpactReport attestation on a completed need. Its refUID must be the DeliveryVerified attestation of the last finalized delivery.
ngo.closeMinimum: Closing early needs at least {minimum} {unit} ({percent}% of the target).
ngo.closeNotOpen: Funding is not open for this need (already closed, not verified yet, or past a deadline).
ngo.closeBelowMinimum: Below the minimum: closing now would revert. Wait for more donations, or let the funding deadline apply the terms.
ngo.releaseOffChain: This need is held by a payment provider: its tranches are released by the custodian’s Settlement attestation, not by this button.
ngo.settlementBody: After a tranche is released, report how it reached the supplier. Gross must equal the tranche; fees across the whole need may not exceed its disclosed cap. Only hashes of your references go on chain.
ngo.settlementNoSchema: The bundled deployment has no Settlement schema. Redeploy the v2 contracts to use it.
ngo.settlementOffChain: This need is held by a payment provider: its custodian attests the settlements, which is what releases each tranche.
ngo.settlementCapHint: This need’s disclosed cap on third-party costs is {percent}%, counted over the whole need.
ngo.settlementSupplierHint: Hashed in your browser; the text itself never leaves it.
ngo.settlementFxHint: Rate source and quote id, if the payout was converted. Hashed in your browser.
ngo.errorKpiHash: The KPI hash must be a non-zero 32-byte hash.
ngo.errorServed: Report at least {minimum} beneficiaries: smaller counts could identify people.
ngo.errorRegion: The region code must fit in 31 bytes.
ngo.errorVerifications: Verifications must be a whole number between 1 and 255.
ngo.errorDossier: Store the needs assessment (or paste its hash): a dossier hash is required.
ngo.errorCustodian: Choose the payment provider that will hold the money.
ngo.errorFundingDeadline: The funding deadline must be in the future.
ngo.errorExecutionDeadline: The delivery deadline must be in the future and after the funding deadline.
ngo.errorMinFunding: Minimum funding must be a percentage between 0.01 and 100.
ngo.errorCostCap: The cost cap must be a percentage between 0 and {max}.
ngo.errorDisclosure: A cost cap above 0% needs a published cost disclosure.
ngo.errorOutcome: Describe the expected outcome: donors are shown its hash.
ngo.custodianNone: No active payment provider is registered. Paste the address of one once the admin has registered it.
ngo.custodianUnavailable: The provider list could not be loaded. Paste the address of a registered payment provider.
ngo.custodianHint: Only this provider will be able to record payments and payouts for the need.
ngo.deadlineHint: End of that day, UTC. Leave empty for no deadline.
ngo.executionDeadlineHint: End of that day, UTC. After it, unreleased money can be returned to donors.
ngo.minFundingHint: 100 means all or nothing. Lower allows partial execution: if at least this share is raised by the deadline, the need goes ahead with tranches scaled down.
ngo.costCapHint: Payment, FX and banking costs, from 0 to {max}%. 0 means no costs may be deducted.
ngo.costDisclosureHint: Explain which costs may be deducted and why. Donors see its hash; publish the text alongside the need.
ngo.expectedOutcomeHint: What the aid will achieve, and what happens if it is only partly funded.
ngo.summaryTarget: Raise {amount} {unit} for {category} in {region}, paid out in {count, plural, one {# tranche} other {# tranches}} ({plan}).
ngo.summaryCustodyOnChain: Donations are held in an on-chain vault and released tranche by tranche.
ngo.summaryCustodyOffChain: Payment provider {custodian} holds the money and must attest every payment in and every payout.
ngo.summaryFundingDeadline: Funding closes at the end of {date} (UTC).
ngo.summaryExecutionDeadline: Delivery must be finished by the end of {date} (UTC); after that, unreleased money is returned.
ngo.summaryAllOrNothing: All or nothing: if the full target is not raised by the deadline, every donor can get a refund.
ngo.summaryPartial: If at least {percent}% of the target is raised by the deadline, the need goes ahead with every tranche scaled down; below that, donors are refunded.
ngo.summaryCosts: Payment, FX and banking costs may take up to {percent}% of what donors pay, as the disclosure explains.
ngo.summaryNoCosts: No third-party costs may be deducted.
ngo.summaryOutcome: The expected outcome is committed as {hash}.
ngo.settlementFeeTooHigh: Fees cannot be larger than the tranche.
ngo.errorExecutionRequired: An on-chain need needs a delivery deadline: it is what lets donors get their money back if the work never happens.
ngo.planBody: The vault pays these payees directly, tranche by tranche. Only registered suppliers can be named, plus the NGO itself for its own disclosed share (at most 25% of the need). The shares of each tranche must add up to 100%.
ngo.planNoSuppliers: No registered supplier was found. An admin registers suppliers on chain; an address can still be pasted, and the contract is the final check.
ngo.planRefHint: Only its hash goes on chain, as the reference for what was agreed.
ngo.planTotals: Tranche totals: {totals} · the NGO takes {ngo}% of the need
ngo.planCount: A payment plan has between one and five payees.
ngo.planAddress: Every payee must be a registered supplier’s address, or the NGO itself.
ngo.planDuplicate: The same payee cannot appear twice in a plan.
ngo.planEmptyPayee: A payee that never receives anything cannot be in the plan.
ngo.planNgoTwice: The NGO can only appear once in the plan.
ngo.planTrancheSum: The shares of every tranche must add up to exactly 100%.
ngo.planNgoCap: The NGO’s own share cannot exceed 25% of the need.

verifier.title: Verifier queue
verifier.subtitle: Needs waiting for verification and deliveries waiting for sign-off. You must be independent of the NGO.
verifier.rejectWarning: A rejection cancels the need permanently. The NGO must create a new one.
verifier.challengeBody: Open a dispute before the challenge window closes. The admin resolves it.
verifier.refUidNote: The sign-off is chained to the evidence attestation ({uid}) through refUID, as the schema requires.
verifier.noEvidence: This delivery has no evidence attestation yet, so it cannot be signed off.
verifier.emptyNeeds: No needs are waiting for verification.
verifier.emptyDeliveries: No deliveries are waiting for sign-off.
verifier.deadlinePassed: A deadline of this need has passed, so it can no longer be verified; it can only expire.

field.title: Field agent
field.subtitle: Open a delivery, upload the evidence, then anchor its hash on chain.
field.openBody: A delivery unlocks one tranche. The previous tranche must already be released, and at least five recipients are required so a count cannot identify anyone.
field.uploadBody: Photos and manifests go to the evidence service, which strips EXIF, encrypts them and pins them. Only the ciphertext hash and the CID reach the chain.
field.attestBody: The DeliveryEvidence attestation links the delivery to the hash the service returned.
field.privacyWarning: Never upload a photo that shows a face, a document or an address you have not been allowed to share.

confirm.title: Confirm you received aid
confirm.lead: This proves you received aid without revealing who you are. Nothing that identifies you leaves this phone.
confirm.step1Body: It is stored only on this device. Show this number to the person enrolling you.
confirm.qrAlt: QR code containing your identity commitment
confirm.step2Body: Your phone builds the proof. It takes a few seconds and needs a connection the first time.
confirm.doneBody: Your confirmation was counted. It cannot be traced back to you, and it cannot be used twice for this delivery.
confirm.notEnrolled: This identity is not enrolled in the program for this delivery. Ask the enrolment desk to add the number above.
confirm.failed: The confirmation could not be sent.
confirm.noMembers: The beneficiary group for this delivery could not be loaded.
confirm.cardModeWarning: Lower security than using your own phone: whoever operates this device sees your card. Only use it at a verifier-operated kiosk.
confirm.cardModeBody: Paste the secret from a card. It is used once and never stored on this device.
confirm.clearIdentity: Forget the identity on this device
confirm.clearConfirm: Forgetting the identity means you can no longer confirm with it. Continue?
confirm.storageUnavailable: This browser blocks local storage, so the identity cannot be kept between visits.
confirm.notOpen: This delivery is not accepting confirmations right now.
confirm.programScoped: This number belongs to this programme only. Another programme gets a different one, so the two cannot be linked to each other.

impact.title: Impact
impact.subtitle: Everything on this page is recomputed from on-chain events and attestations. Nothing is self-reported.
impact.reportsBody: Each one is an EAS attestation chained to the last verified delivery of its need.

custody.OnChainBody: Donations sit in a smart-contract vault and can only leave it tranche by tranche, to the suppliers the need named, under the rules below.
custody.OffChainBody: A regulated payment provider holds the money. It must attest every payment it receives and every tranche it pays out, under the same rules.

terms.title: Terms
terms.note: What the NGO committed to when it registered this need. These terms were fixed on chain at creation and cannot be changed.
terms.allOrNothing: All or nothing: unless the full target is raised by the funding deadline, the need expires and donors can claim refunds.
terms.partialAllowed: Partial execution allowed: if at least {percent}% of the target is raised by the funding deadline, the need goes ahead with every tranche scaled down to what was raised. Below that, donors are refunded.
terms.feesSoFar: Fees attested so far: {amount} {unit} ({percent}% of what donors paid).
terms.expectedOutcomeNote: Hash of the outcome and partial-execution terms the NGO published with the need.

settlements.title: Settlements
settlements.note: After a tranche is paid out, a Settlement attestation reconciles it: the amount, the fees intermediaries kept and a hashed supplier reference.

give.title: Give by card or bank transfer
give.sandbox: Sandbox payment: no real money moves and no card details are ever asked for. The provider settles in the need’s currency; in the sandbox it settles one for one, so the figures below are what the need receives.
give.onlyWay: A payment provider holds this need’s money (Model A), so it cannot receive wallet donations. Card or bank transfer is the way to give.
give.closed: This need is not accepting donations right now.
give.capZero: This need allows no third-party costs, so only fee-free payments can be recorded against it.
give.capNote: Fees are capped by this need’s disclosed limit of {percent}% on third-party costs.
give.overCap: This fee is above the need’s disclosed cap. The provider may not be able to record it: choose a bank transfer or a larger amount.
give.error: The payment could not be started: {detail}

track.title: Track a donation
track.subtitle: Follow one donation from verification to confirmed impact. No account and no login.
track.privacyNote: A tracking reference identifies a donation, not a donor: it is a receipt number, a salted payment reference or a deposit address, and nothing on this page says who gave.
track.formHint: Your receipt number (e.g. 12), the payment reference you received (0x followed by 64 characters) or your deposit address (0x followed by 40 characters).
track.invalidRefTitle: That is not a tracking reference
track.invalidRef: Use a receipt number (e.g. 12), a payment reference (0x followed by 64 hexadecimal characters) or a deposit address (0x followed by 40).
track.notFoundBody: Nothing is indexed under this reference. A payment you just made can take a minute to appear; check the reference and try again shortly.
track.tranchesNote: Each tranche shows its full amount and your pro-rata share of it.
track.followBody: This page is public and needs no login. Bookmark it or share the link.
track.alertsBody: Be told when this donation reaches its next stage.
track.embedBody: Show this tracker on your own site. It refreshes itself every minute.
track.stageBody_Verified: Independent verifiers attested the need before any money could move.
track.stageBody_Funded: Funding closed and the money was split into tranches.
track.stageBody_Settled: A tranche was paid out and its payout reconciled by a Settlement attestation.
track.stageBody_Delivered: A delivery passed field evidence, anonymous beneficiary confirmations, a verifier sign-off and its challenge window.
track.stageBody_ImpactConfirmed: The NGO published an impact report chained to the last verified delivery.
track.outcomeBody_InProgress: The need is moving through its stages. Every step below links to its on-chain proof.
track.outcomeBody_Completed: Every tranche was delivered and released. Thank you.
track.outcomeBody_Refundable: This need did not go ahead as planned, and the unreleased part of your donation can be returned.
track.outcomeBody_Refunded: The unreleased part of this donation has been returned.
track.outcomeBody_Expired: A deadline passed before the need could be completed.
track.refundHintWallet: Claim it from the need’s page, with the wallet you donated from.
track.refundHintPayment: The payment provider returns it to your original payment method.
track.widgetOffline: The live status is temporarily unavailable. It will refresh automatically.
track.depositBody: Money sent to this address is converted on-chain and donated to the need. Each sweep shows what was sent, its fair value at Chainlink prices, what reached the need and what the conversion cost.
track.depositWaitingBody: Nothing has been donated from this deposit address yet. Once funds arrive and are swept, this page follows the donation through its stages.
track.depositWaitingWidget: Nothing has been donated from this deposit address yet. This tracker updates once funds arrive.
track.refundHintDeposit: Use your refund-key file in the deposit address section below. If the receipt went to your wallet, claim from the need’s page with that wallet.
track.payeesNote: Who this need’s vault pays, and your donation’s part of what each of them has received so far — your share of the need applied to every payment.

alerts.emailHint: Used only for these alerts, and deleted when you unsubscribe.
alerts.webhookHint: A signed JSON POST is sent to this URL at each new stage; the signing secret is shown once you subscribe.
alerts.invalidWebhook: Enter a full http:// or https:// URL, without a username or password.
alerts.createdEmail: Done. Alerts for this donation will go to your email.
alerts.createdWebhook: Done. Alerts for this donation will be posted to your webhook.
alerts.keepToken: Keep the details below: they are the only way to unsubscribe (and, for a webhook, to verify deliveries), and they are shown only once. We do not keep a copy you can recover.
alerts.removed: Unsubscribed. No more alerts will be sent.
alerts.unsubscribeBody: Enter the subscription id and the unsubscribe token you were shown when you signed up.
alerts.webhookSecretHint: Every delivery is signed. Check the {signature} header against the raw request body with this secret before trusting it. Deliveries also carry {headers}.

conversion.noCosts: This need allows no intermediary costs, so it cannot take money that has to be converted. Give USDC directly, or by bank transfer.
conversion.costCapNote: Conversion costs count against this need’s disclosed {percent}% cap on intermediary costs; a donation that would exceed it is stopped before you sign.
conversion.revertFeeCap: This conversion would take the need’s intermediary costs above its disclosed cap, so the contract would reject it. Try a smaller amount, or give USDC directly.
conversion.revertNotAccepting: This need is no longer accepting donations.
conversion.revertSlippage: The swap would return less than the slippage bound allows right now. Try again in a moment or with a smaller amount.
conversion.revertPrice: The Chainlink price is stale or unavailable right now, so the conversion cannot be priced. Try again later.
conversion.revertRoute: This token cannot be converted on this deployment.
conversion.revertBalance: Your wallet does not hold enough of this token.
conversion.revertPaused: The system is paused; nothing can be donated right now.
conversion.revertOther: The donation would fail ({reason}), so nothing was sent.

onramp.title: Pay by card
onramp.body: Buy USDC with your card into your own wallet, then donate it with one tap.
onramp.sandbox: Sandbox: no card is charged. Worthless test USDC is minted to your wallet, priced with the EUR/USD feed, minus a simulated 1.5% card fee.
onramp.coinbaseNote: You pay on Coinbase (sign in or create an account) and Coinbase’s fees apply. The USDC is delivered to your own wallet, as Coinbase’s terms require.
onramp.closed: This need is not accepting donations right now.
onramp.step1Body: Any wallet you control works: MetaMask or another extension, or a Coinbase Smart Wallet created with a passkey on this device (nothing to install, no seed phrase).
onramp.connect: Create or connect with a passkey
onramp.amountRange: Enter an amount between {min} and {max} EUR.
onramp.step3Body: Coinbase opens in a new tab. Come back here once you have paid: this page notices when the USDC arrives.
onramp.step3BodyMock: The sandbox mints test USDC to your wallet straight away.
onramp.mockMinted: Sandbox payment of {eur} EUR at EUR/USD {rate}: {fee} USDC card fee ({percent}%), {usdc} USDC sent to your wallet.
onramp.waiting: Waiting for the USDC to arrive in your wallet…
onramp.statusFailed: Coinbase reports that the payment failed. Start over to try again.
onramp.statusDelivered: Coinbase has sent the USDC; waiting for your wallet balance to update…
onramp.step4Body: Once the USDC is in your wallet, one tap approves and donates it, with gas sponsored when possible. Anything beyond what the need still needs is returned to your wallet.
onramp.thanks: Thank you. Your USDC was donated.
onramp.error: The purchase could not be started: {detail}
onramp.arrivedReturned: The need can only take part of it; about {returned} USDC comes back to your wallet.
onramp.balanceUnavailable: Could not read your USDC balance; try again in a moment.

deposit.title: Send from an exchange
deposit.body: Get a deposit address for this need and withdraw USDC to it from an exchange or any wallet. It is donated directly on-chain here; it can only ever be donated to this need or refunded.
deposit.closed: This need is not accepting donations right now.
deposit.creditWallet: Send the donation receipt to my connected wallet ({address})
deposit.noWallet: Connect a wallet first if you want the soulbound receipt in it. Otherwise the deposit address itself is credited and your refund key controls its refunds.
deposit.refundToHint: A wallet you control on Base. Leftovers and refunds go there without needing your key. Do not use an exchange deposit address.
deposit.saveBody: This file holds the key that can send money back out of your deposit address if the need closes, is cancelled or receives more than it needs. It exists only in this browser: nobody, including this website, can recover it for you.
deposit.copyFailed: Could not copy; download the file instead.
deposit.saveFirst: Download or copy the refund key to continue.
deposit.reveal: I saved it: show my deposit address
deposit.mismatch: The server created a different address than this browser computed, so it is not shown. Please start over.
deposit.error: The deposit address could not be created: {detail}
deposit.fileNotice: Proof of Aid refund key. Whoever holds this file can direct refunds from this deposit address: keep it private and do not lose it.
deposit.qrAlt: QR code of the deposit address
deposit.warning: Send only {tokens} on {network}. Other tokens are not converted, and anything sent on another network is lost.
deposit.readyHint: Funds are converted and donated when the address is swept, which you can trigger from its tracking page.
deposit.noSweeps: Nothing has been swept from this address yet.
deposit.holdingHint: Funds are waiting at the address. Sweep them to donate them; anything that is not {unit} is converted on the way in.
deposit.emptyHint: Nothing waiting. This updates every few seconds.
deposit.outcome_notAccepting: the need is no longer accepting donations; the money stays at the address and can be refunded
deposit.outcome_overCostCap: converting it would exceed the need’s disclosed cost cap; it stays at the address and can be refunded
deposit.outcome_notKeeper: this site cannot sweep this address; its receipt or refund wallet can
deposit.refundBody: Load the refund-key file you saved when you created this address. The refund is signed in this browser; the key is never uploaded.
deposit.keyProblem_malformed: That is not a Proof of Aid refund-key file.
deposit.keyProblem_wrongChain: That refund key is for another network.
deposit.keyProblem_wrongAddress: That refund key belongs to a different deposit address.
deposit.keyProblem_keyMismatch: The key in that file does not match this deposit address’s refund signer.
deposit.refundDestinationHint: A wallet you control on this network, not an exchange deposit address.
deposit.nothingHeld: The address holds nothing to refund right now.
deposit.vaultRefundByWallet: This donation’s receipt is held by {wallet}; that wallet claims the refund on the need’s page.
deposit.refundVaultButton: Claim this address’s refund from the vault
deposit.sweepFromWalletHint: Your connected wallet is this address’s receipt or refund address, so it can sweep it too.

plan.title: Who the vault pays
plan.note: This need’s money goes straight from its vault to the suppliers below, in the shares fixed on chain when the need was created and verified with it. The NGO receives only the share it disclosed.
plan.heldNote: A payment was released but the stablecoin would not deliver it (a frozen address). It stays in the vault for that payee and anyone can deliver it once the address can receive again; until then this need is not finished.
plan.paymentHeld: of tranche {index} held for {payee}: the token refused it

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.subtitle: The vetted providers a vault may pay directly. A need’s payment plan can only name addresses registered here, and every payment below is a vault transaction anyone can check.
suppliers.emptyBody: Until one is, on-chain needs cannot be created: a vault always pays a registered supplier.
suppliers.notFound: No supplier is registered at this address.
suppliers.paymentsNote: Every tranche share a vault sent to this supplier, newest last.
